newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 14.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Members of parliament and associations criticise lack of ambition they see in government's draft bill against social exclusion.
-- Airline group TAT-Air Liberte carry on with strike without time limit.
-- Despite denials by Credit Lyonnais, doubt remains over possible sale of German subsidiary BfG Bank .
-- Casino managing director Yves Martin to join Club Mediterranee marketing division.
